mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been declining for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting reduced consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >70% of instances where UNRATE crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and contraction in supply (low INDPRO) creates inflationary pressures, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in >50% of instances where GDPC1 is rising and INDPRO is below its 50th percentile over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (e.g., rising FEDFUNDS), higher interest rates compress equity discount rates and reduce growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >80% of instances during periods classified as monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate coupled with rising labor demand (HOUST) signals accommodative monetary policy and strong employment growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in >70% of instances where FEDFUNDS is declining and HOUST is rising for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the supply index (INDPRO) below 105 triggers inflationary pressures, elevating equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 105.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in employment (PAYEMS) reflects a robust labor market, stimulating consumer demand and corporate earnings, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in >75% of instances where PAYEMS shows a sustained upward trend over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, elevated demand (GDPC1) signals peak market valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate a downturn.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >80% of instances during periods classified as late-cycle expansions.
